article_content: In Los Angeles, 19-year-old Ruben Jurado has been charged with attempted murder following the shooting of Army Spc. Christopher Sullivan at his Second Communion celebration. Detained at West Valley Detention Center, Jurado's arraignment is imminent. Sullivan, a decorated survivor of an attack in Afghanistan that left him paralyzed, is receiving unwavering support. His family clings to the hope for justice, all while cherishing the moments shared with Sullivan prior to his military service. Meanwhile, the flag of the 101st Airborne Division, Sullivan's brother's division, is a poignant reminder of their shared military brotherhood.

Detenido en el Centro de Detención West Valley, se espera su aparición en juicio. Sullivan, veterano condecorado y paralizado después de un ataque en Afganistán, está recibiendo apoyo. Su familia aguanta ansiosamente por justicia, honrando los momentos compartidos con Sullivan antes de su servicio militar. La bandera de la división Avisera 101, del hermano de Sullivan, sirve como una conmovedora memoria de su hermandad militar.
